rows.grounds: woman of the lowest birth; object of the forthcoming explanation
manner of explanation, according to actual state; compound yathā+sthitam

items.question: In what manner will the nature of the outcaste woman be declared to the goddess?
premises: The speaker promises to declare the outcaste woman.
The goddess is directly addressed and told to listen.
The declaration will be made according to the actual state of things.
items.inference: The outcaste woman will be explained truthfully and directly to the attentive goddess.
uncertainties: Whether antyajā functions as the subject of an implied clause or the topic of the declaration is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: O goddess, listen; I shall declare the outcaste woman as she truly is.
